# Description

---

> ℹ️ **Preview links are scoped to what you touched:** CI posts a "🌐 Preview Deployments" comment linking each app's real `<app>-preview.tabitha.bible` preview -- but only for the apps this PR's changes actually affect (including dependents of a shared package you touched), so a PR touching only root docs, `.github/`, or tooling gets **no** preview comment at all -- that's expected, not a stuck pipeline. See [#74](https://github.com/presciencelabs/tabitha/issues/74) for the original scoping history and [the ADR](../docs/decisions/0015-cross-app-preview-custom-domains.md) for how these previews work.
